_about: THE NAMES OF THE BOOKS JAMES IS RENAMING. One record per book: `id` never changes (it is the book's folder under client/public/ebook/ and its cover's file name); `slug`, `title` and `subtitle` are the name in use; `was` lists each earlier name, oldest first. TO RENAME A BOOK: copy its current slug, title and subtitle into `was`, write the new ones, then run `node scripts/sync-book-names.mjs` (it rewrites every page, list, script, redirect and text file that carries the name), `node scripts/build-covers.mjs` and `pnpm run search:index`. `fileTitle` is the title printed inside the PDF and EPUB; while it differs from `title` the site says "Published earlier as ...". Change it when James's corrected files are in place. docs/work/elite/bookshelf.md has the whole procedure.
